messages:
Amy Chen: Quick UX check: outbound IP/CIDR field in Private setup is causing support confusion. Current copy just says 'Enter allowed IP ranges' which customers read as inbound.
Jake Ortiz: saw that too. can we clarify direction and show an example? placeholder alone isn't enough.
Marta Ivanova: Proposed label: 'Outbound IP ranges (CIDR)'. Helper: 'CIDR format; comma or newline separated. Example: 10.0.0.0/16.' Add a 'What is CIDR?' helper link below.
Samir Patel: backend accepts comma/newline and validates. we'll return per-range errors. recommend inline per-line validation and keep focus inside input on error.
Amy Chen: accessibility: input should have aria-describedby to the helper, errors announce via role=alert, aria-invalid on bad input.
Jake Ortiz: layout: persistent helper under field (not placeholder). also add small 'Test outbound connectivity' action that triggers preflight and shows per-range reachable/unreachable.
Marta Ivanova: contrast and keyboard flow check will be in figma. will update tokens and push frame by EOD.
setup-bot: Preflight queued for 1781234567 — will post results when complete.
Amy Chen: thanks, aim to land copy + a11y tweaks next sprint. :rocket:
